summary: layered installer dashboard and idempotent setup runner
reads: Python package index / configured pip indexes (external, confirm-gated)
Ollama daemon and model registry (external/local, confirm-gated)
hints: Bare `ops setup` is a read-only layered dashboard. `ops setup <layer>` advances one layer idempotently. Search and model layers can install Python packages and pull Ollama models into external stores, so they require `--yes`; backups is a human handoff and is never included in `--all`. `--dry-run` previews any advance (single layer or `--all`) without installing/writing and needs no `--yes`.
